biography.plain_text: Michael A. Bozzuto is an American food-distribution businessman who leads the family company founded by his father, Adam. Based in Cheshire, Connecticut, Bozzuto’s supplies independent retailers across the Northeast. A Stetson University graduate, he became president and chief executive in 1994 and subsequently chairman, combining ownership with the expansion of the business.

long_biography.plain_text:
A small motorcycle fundraiser became the starting point for Michael A. Bozzuto’s Hometown Foundation. The food-company executive developed the organisation from Hometown Wheels, a ride launched in 2001 to raise money for Special Olympics. Established the following year, the foundation brought his company, its retailers and other businesses together to support community programmes.

The resulting Dream Ride Experience combines fundraising with participation by people with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Its Dream Cruise pairs participants with drivers for outings in distinctive cars, while the foundation’s retailer campaign helps people attend the event. Alongside this work, the organisation supports animal welfare, emergency responders, people facing major illness and military communities.
